title.en: An Act Fixing the Maximum Compensation of Municipal Vice-Mayors and Councilors
title.orig: An Act Fixing the Maximum Compensation of Municipal Vice-Mayors and Councilors

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_6090_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
In lieu of per diem s, the municipal council may grant to each Vice-Mayor and councilor an annual salary not to exceed the following:
Class of Municipality
Salary per annum First Class—1 ₱4,800.00 First Class—2 4,500.00 First Class—3 4,200.00 First Class—4 3,900.00 First Class—5 3,600.00 First Class—6 3,300.00 Second Class 3,000.00 Third Class 2,400.00

Municipalities of the fourth, fifth, sixth and seventh classes shall not be covered by the provisions of this Act: Provided, however, That the Municipal Councils of the municipalities belonging to these classes may grant to each Vice-Mayor and Councilor a per diem not exceeding fifteen pesos for every day of regular or special session of the Council actually attended by them: Provided, finally, That no per diem may be granted for more than two special sessions a month.
All Acts, executive orders and administrative orders, or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this Act are hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, August 4, 1969.
